Definition: apparently a primary word; a year:--year.
BiblicalUsage: Étos is a year — the measure of a life, counted one year at a time. Anna the prophetess was a widow of eighty-four years; Abraham's seed would be strangers four hundred years; and with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. It is the word for time given and time spent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe étos teaches me to number my days: the years are God's gift, and He asks me to spend them wisely. I hold that a thousand years in His sight is a reminder, not an excuse — my years are short, and they matter.
RelatedEvents: The Birth of Jesus; Martyrdom of Stephen
